name: Picostocks
rootCause: Picostocks, a centralized Bitcoin investment platform, suffered a major private key compromise on 17 February 2014. Approximately $4.4 million was stolen when attackers accessed the platform’s wallet credentials. The attacker obtained the private key(s) controlling Picostocks' Bitcoin wallet, enabling unauthorized withdrawal and transfer of platform funds.
